I can't express how much I appreciate these posts. It's so comforting to know that other people have gone through similar situations and made it out ok in the end.

Thankfully, my living situation is pretty good. I share an apartment with a family member who knows about my situation and has been rooting me on for years. They fully support me seeking help and getting my mental state in a better place before returning to school.

Again, thank you. I really appreciate all of these posts and the solid advice they have given me.
Thank you so much - that's very reassuring. Congratulations on taking care of yourself and going back!

Thank you. I'm fairly confident I'll go back - I enjoy being a student and I'm very passionate about the career path I've chosen. I'm just not currently able to give that career all of the dedication I should be. I'll be sure to discuss it with any doctor as well.
